text: {"lessons":["My account is up overall, but monthly changes have included declines as well as gains; I should not assume the upward trend will continue.","Selling part of Stock C after a large gain and part of Stock D after a small gain shows that I can trim positions selectively; I should base future trades on my needs and risk, not just recent returns.","I have traded infrequently and still seen my account fluctuate, so I should avoid reacting to every monthly move and keep decisions measured."]}
